Agent: OpenCode (Plan + Build). Criterion: original tests pass; compile. Values aggregated per instruction category (over the 16 combinations containing it x 5 libraries = 80 variants). (1) Agent files + OpenCode + Gemma 4-26B-A4B (local): compile 88.39% overall (RepoOvw 87.50, FuncDec 81.25, ImpDetl 86.25, TestCas 88.75, ReConStp 86.25); Passed 0% for all categories; Partial 13.75-20.00% (FuncDec highest 20.00); overall 17.42% partial; tokens for agent-file generation 68,070-415,253. Quality: does not work; cost: partly. (2) Agent files + OpenCode + GPT-5.4 (API): compile 98.06% overall (97.50-98.75); Passed 6.25% (ImpDetl) to 16.25% (ReConStp), overall 12.99%; Partial 50.00-58.75% (overall 51.32%); tokens 78,148-888,781 (highest RepoOvw-FuncDec-ImpDetl-ReConStp on compactor). Quality: partly; cost: partly. Structural similarity: CC and FC close to originals (Gemma within 2.47% for 3 libraries; GPT within 13.58% for 4), LoF and FL far smaller (-16% to -98%)

Tasks: reconstruct 5 trivial Python libraries. Configurations: 31 instruction-category combinations x 2 LLMs (Gemma 4-26B-A4B, GPT-5.4) in one harness (OpenCode); no baseline without agent file. Held constant: prompts (role/directive/context/consideration), harness, agent modes, only AGENTS.md in working directory. Acceptance tests: original human-written test suites, unmodified. Repetitions: 1 run per library and combination. Human intervention: Not stated (plan review possible). Experiments in April 2026

Token usage not determined by number of categories; model and library matter more (compactor highest). GPT-5.4 > Gemma 4 on compile (98.06 vs 88.39%) and tests (12.99% vs 0% full pass). Best category: ReConStp for GPT-5.4 full pass (16.25%, +3.75 points over next), FuncDec for Gemma partial (20%, +1.25). More categories do not improve correctness (best with 1-3 categories). ReConStp most frequent among closest LoF and CC; TestCas and ReConStp for FL and FC. No statistical tests

Distinguished models clearly; differences between instruction categories small (1.25-3.75 points) and not tested for significance. Repeatability: single run per condition. Limitations stated: nondeterminism, agent files leak content across categories, single run, trivial libraries, two LLMs, one harness, one task type

Token usage measures cost not agent-file quality; tests may not cover all behaviour; no maintainability, security, performance evaluation; nondeterminism and prompt sensitivity; categories not isolated in generated files; single run; five trivial Python libraries, two LLMs, one harness (OpenCode), one task; findings preliminary. Future: instruction-level benchmarks, automated instruction selection, larger systems, repetitions, other harnesses and formats

Inconsistencies: filter text requires <= 35 LoF or max CC <= 10, but Table II LoF values are 1,156-26,395 (only CC filter holds); RQ2a answer says Testing had the highest compilation rate, but in Table V GPT-5.4 ties at 98.75% for four categories (Testing highest only for Gemma, 88.75%); Table V has "86,25". Tables III, IV, VII flattened by pdftotext; Table VI values read by column order. Replication package: Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.23359831 (agent files, metrics, scripts). Pre-registration: not claimed.
